limitations.quote: registered-output timing guidance to check when `read_data` samples the RAM.
limitations.note: The timing guidance did not help locate the defect, which was in the RAM reset loop rather than in when the read port sampled data.

Replacing both enable ternaries with `if` statements preserved behavior for known enables but changed four-state simulation: an `X` or `Z` enable now holds the value instead of merging the old and new values bit by bit.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire verification script to be rejected before compilation, so the agent had to resubmit the same checks in a different wrapper.
